concerns.text: JwtAuthenticationFilter performs database user role lookup synchronously on every request without caching, which may impact API response latency under high load.
MoodleRoleSyncService falls back to a non-atomic SQL UPDATE if atomic user role update returns 0 rows updated.
JWKS key fetching synchronously parses JSON on each request; caching public keys would improve performance.
MoodleRoleOverride component could benefit from optimistic UI updates when overriding individual user roles.
Filtering PROTOCOL documents in memory after repository retrieval rather than in the SQL query could affect pagination totals.
DataErasureToken entity relies on default cascading behavior; explicit expiration cleanup background job could be added in a follow-up.
